title: Not bad but somewhat disappointing
text: Slightly disappointed in what came in my first box.  I got a cropped t-shirt, body wipes, a sports drink, a sample of clarity sleep drink mix and some other unmemorable small items I think. For the price I thought it would have been better. I used to have a miss muscle box subscription and the reason I stopped was because after 18 I started getting the same stuff again. I heard good things about gainzbox so I figured since they were similarly priced I would give it a try. I will wait and see what comes in my next box before I cancel but I’m not super impressed yet.
label: neutral
